abstract: A human gestational uterine choriocarcinoma cell line (NJG) was established in vitro. The NJG cell line had been subcultured more than 73 times over 7 years. The cells consisted mainly of Langhans-like cells, while multinucleated cells were occasionally seen. The cells grew in a monolayered sheet, showing a tendency to pile up, with the population doubling in 80 hrs. Electron-microscopically, desmosomes were characteristically observed, which suggested that the cultured cells were of epithelial origin. Chromosomal analysis revealed aneuploidy with a hypertriploid mode and 4 marker chromosomes. Immunocyto- and-histochemical staining for tumor markers of the cultured cells and the transplanted tumors to nude mice showed close similarity. SP1 was occasionally demonstrated and PP5 was faintly stained only in the heterotransplanted tumors, although PP10 and PP12 were not demonstrable. HCG was localized not only in syncytial cells, but also in Langhans cells, and syncytial cells without hCG were also observed in the tumors. A single cell clone was also established from the original NJG cells by a limiting dilution method. The heterotransplanted tumor consisted of Langhans and syncytial cells, indicating that both cells originated from the same cell.
abstract_ja: ヒト妊娠性子宮絨毛癌細胞株(NJG)をin vitroで樹立した。NJG細胞株は7年間に73回以上継代された。細胞は主にLanghans様細胞からなり、多核細胞が時折みられた。細胞は単層シート状に増殖し、積み重なる傾向を示した。集団倍加時間は80時間であった。電子顕微鏡で特徴的にデスモソームが観察され、培養細胞が上皮由来であることが示唆された。染色体解析では過二倍体モードを伴う異数性と4本のマーカー染色体が認められた。培養細胞およびヌードマウスへの移植腫瘍の腫瘍マーカーに対する免疫細胞化学・組織化学染色は、非常によく類似していた。SP1は時折検出され、PP5は移植腫瘍でのみ微弱に染色されたが、PP10およびPP12は検出されなかった。hCGは合胞体細胞だけでなくLanghans細胞にも局在し、hCG陰性の合胞体細胞も腫瘍内で観察された。元のNJG細胞から限界希釈法により単一細胞クローンも樹立した。異種移植腫瘍はLanghans細胞と合胞体細胞から構成されており、両細胞が同一の細胞に由来することが示された。
